title: [storage] While how long the disk lasts cannot be measured yet, the storage card says from when it will be
prompt:
Read crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/storage.rs (objective 085's `growth_parts`, each measured against the oldest sample of the last 7 days that carries it; objective 083's `growth_from_ms`), web/src/resources.ts (`storageView`, `measured_from`, `localDateTime`) and web/src/components/fleet/HealthStrip.tsx (the Storage card's last line).

This comes after objectives 083 ("measured from" for the archive's growth) and 085 (how long the disk lasts from every persistent grower). Both must be in the tree.

The problem (rev-g's N3 on 085; the lead, 2026-11-12; lead-mac's 11:35 question). Since 085, how long the disk lasts runs on the growth of the archive, Claude Code's transcripts and the database, and each part needs its own sample at least a day old. Samples from before 085 carry no database size, so for about a day after the deploy "How long the disk lasts" is blank. The card then says "not measured yet", as if nothing were coming. 083 says when the archive's own growth comes; nothing says when days left does.

Required behaviour.
(a) `GET /api/fleet`'s `health.storage` carries `persistent_from_ms`: the moment the persistent growth is first measured. That is the latest of its three parts' moments, each being the at_ms of the oldest sample of the last 7 days that carries the part, plus one day. It is null while any part has no such sample, or without a workspace root.
(b) web/src/resources.ts: `normalizeStorage` keeps `persistent_from_ms`, and `storageView(storage)` carries `lasts_from`. While `days_left` is null and persistent_from_ms is after the storage's read_at_ms, `lasts_from` is the local date and time of persistent_from_ms (localDateTime, e.g. "2026-11-13 07:31"); otherwise it is null. `lasts`, the rows and 083's `measured_from` are unchanged. The module keeps loading with node alone.
(c) The card's last line says "How long the disk lasts: measured from <lasts_from>" while it is set, and is as today otherwise. Read off a screenshot.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/091.sh. The history is seeded as the store holds it: a host.storage sample 30 h old in the old shape (archive and projects only), and one 10 h old with the database's size too, over a 3 MiB archive. `spawn serve` answers. Checks:
- (1) Through `GET /api/fleet`: days_left and persistent_growth_bytes_per_day are null, and persistent_from_ms is the 10 h sample's at_ms plus one day.
- (2) Under node with TZ=Asia/Shanghai:
  - over that answer, storageView's lasts is null and lasts_from is the local date and time of persistent_from_ms;
  - a persistent_from_ms of 2026-11-12 23:31:20 UTC, an hour after read_at_ms, gives "2026-11-13 07:31";
  - with days left (40) it gives lasts_from null and lasts "about 40 days at …";
  - a moment already past, or none, gives null.
It fails with 1 on f41cbcc1: there is no persistent_from_ms, and storageView has no lasts_from. Its throwaway stacks the throwaways of 083 and 085 (sync/obj-091/throwaway.diff).

Expected on live: right after 085's deploy, the card reads "How long the disk lasts: measured from <the first database-carrying sample + 24 h>". Once that moment passes, the days show and the line goes back to "about <n> days at …".

The product reason. It turns a blank that looks like a fault into a date, on the storage north star itself. Monitoring only: no gate, integrator or deploy step reads it.

Rules: never edit the protected paths, which the gate rejects: rsi/, scripts/ (scripts/rsi/, scripts/blackbox/, scripts/e2e.sh among them), deploy/, all of web/ except web/src/, web/test/ and web/index.html, rust-toolchain files and .cargo/. The gate also rejects fewer runnable tests than the base, any lint relaxation and any build-time code. The gate builds offline from the cargo caches already on the host. Keep every existing check green (065, 074, 083 and 085 among them) and add tests of your own for the new behaviour: a serve/storage unit test of persistent_from_ms (a part without a sample, all three, the latest of them), and web/test cases of lasts_from (pending, measured, past, none).
